name: openpond
description: Manage OpenPond models, datasets, graders, experiments and training from your agent.

interface.shortDescription: Train and evaluate your own models
interface.longDescription: Work with your OpenPond workspace's models, experiments, datasets and graders. Inspect training readiness, retained results and authorized credit balances; prepare and manage supported training within your permissions and approved limits. Runtime availability depends on the selected method and source.
defaultPrompt: Show my models and recent training results.
Help me prepare an experiment with my dataset and grader.
Review my continual-learning policy and pending candidates.
